subject: Variance request: early exit & staggered downsize provisions — BluePeak Health
body:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Variance request: early exit & staggered downsize provisions — BluePeak Health

Marissa —

BluePeak (pilot) just sent redlines to the SOW. They want a pilot opt-out + early termination path that lets them downsize without immediate full penalties. Key asks from the customer:
- Pilot opt-out within 30 days (no termination fee)
- If they terminate after pilot, a 3-month staggered credit schedule (60% credit month 1, 40% month 2, 20% month 3) applied to remaining committed spend
- A temporary downsize protection: they can reduce committed capacity by up to 30% once during the first 90 days without repricing

Attached: BluePeak_SOW_redlines.pdf, MA_plan_v3.xlsx, and a quick credit calc (credit_calc_jonas.xlsx).

My read: this is a mid-sized pilot (estimated ARR if converted ~$480k). The requested protections increase downside materially and are outside standard ramp/opt-out language. I think we can offer a capped staggered-credit schedule but need exec clearance for cap and for allowing a one-time 30% downsize during the 90-day window.

Requesting: expedited exec approval or guidance on hard limits (max $ credit, notice period, whether opt-out is limited to pilots < 3 months).

Next steps: If approved, I will send updated SOW and route through DocuSign.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

----------

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 14:30:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Variance request: early exit & staggered downsize provisions — BluePeak Health

Jonas — thanks for the heads up and the attachments. Quick summary for clarity:
- Pilot opt-out: customer asks for 30-day opt-out with no fee (we normally allow 14-day pilot opt-out or customer pays pro-rata for committed capacity)
- Staggered credit: 60/40/20 over three months applied to "remaining committed spend" — customer wants full application to remaining term
- One-time 30% downsize during first 90 days without repricing

I ran a preliminary credit calc (attached). Worst-case exposure if they exercise everything and churn immediately would be ~= $150k (rough calc).

Recommendation: escalate to Rishi for approval because this changes our standard caps and would set a precedent. Questions for exec:
1) Max total credit allowed as a dollar or % of remaining ARR?
2) Minimum notice period for opt-out/termination (we should consider 30/60 days)
3) Limit pilot opt-out to pilots <= 3 months?

If we get a yes with caps, legal will need to update SOW language to:
- define "staggered credit" mechanics clearly (applied to remaining monthly commitments, capped at $X or Y% of remaining ARR)
- require written notice and confirmation period

Marissa
Deal Desk Lead — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

----------

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Variance request: early exit & staggered downsize provisions — BluePeak Health

Reviewed — I can approve a constrained variance with the following conditions:
1) Staggered credit schedule approved but capped at the lesser of $120,000 or 25% of the outstanding ARR at time of termination. Credits apply to monthly committed spend only; no credits against professional services fees.
2) One-time downsize of up to 30% within the first 90 days is permitted, provided the customer gives 60 days' written notice and accepts the adjusted per-unit pricing after the downsize window.
3) Pilot opt-out can be 30 days only if the pilot term is <= 90 days; for pilots longer than 90 days, standard 14-day opt-out applies.
4) Require legal to update the SOW and Master Agreement language to include the mechanics and cap; customer signature via DocuSign required before variances take effect.
5) Approval is contingent on Deal Desk confirming expected downside exposure and setting a reserve in HubSpot.

Marissa/Jonas — please confirm you will:
- incorporate these caps in the SOW redline (legal to draft)
- add a HubSpot deal note and set a $120k reserve if exposure > $50k

Rishi
VP Sales — Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

----------

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: BluePeak Health Sales <sales@bluepeakhealth.com>, Ellen Barnes <ellen.barnes@bluepeakhealth.com>, Michael Chen <michael.chen@bluepeakhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Variance request: early exit & staggered downsize provisions — BluePeak Health

Ellen / Michael —

Thanks for sending over the redlines. We reviewed internally and can agree to a constrained variance to support your pilot. High-level summary of what we can accept (final language to follow in redlined SOW):
- Pilot opt-out: 30-day opt-out allowed for pilots <= 90 days. For pilots > 90 days, 14-day opt-out applies.
- Staggered credit schedule: 60% month 1, 40% month 2, 20% month 3 applied to monthly committed spend, capped at the lesser of $120,000 or 25% of remaining ARR at termination. Credits do not apply to professional services.
- One-time downsize: allowed up to 30% within first 90 days with 60 days' written notice. Pricing for reduced capacity will be adjusted after notice period.

Next steps from our side:
1) Marissa / Legal: I will route the SOW redline and include Rishi's caps.
2) Once legal finalizes language, I will send DocuSign for signature.
3) I will add a note to the HubSpot deal (RWD-2027-00428) and set the reserve per Deal Desk guidance.

We appreciate BluePeak's desire to limit vendor risk during pilot — hope this calibrated compromise keeps things moving.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: BluePeak_SOW_redlines.pdf (redlines), MA_plan_v3.xlsx (commercial plan), credit_calc_jonas.xlsx (exposure calc)
